heroHeadline: Russian Barrage Kills 3 Civilians, Knocks Out Power for 600,000 as Meloni Warns Trump's Putin Deal is 'Very Risky'
heroSubtitle: A Russian missile and drone barrage killed at least 3 civilians and left 600,000 Ukrainians without power. Italian PM Meloni publicly condemned Trump's approach to a Putin deal as 'very risky,' while Zelensky continued diplomatic outreach across Europe.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government reports, UN monitoring missions, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical data draws on peer-reviewed scholarship. Casualty figures are contested; ranges reflect scholarly and official estimates.
